description: Stadt Dortmund: Mobilfunkstationen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoweb1.digistadtdo.de. Locations of mobile phone stations. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Dortmund: Mobile phone stations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Mobilfunk. The listing shows 2022-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
